name: token-usage-tracker
description: Track your Claude Code token usage: rate-limit windows, API-equivalent spend, cache, project and tool analytics in a status bar and panel dashboard.

claudeTracker.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI for the "Claude Code" terminal profile. Empty uses `claude` on PATH, then the CLI bundled with the Claude Code extension.

claudeTracker.claudeDir.description: Claude Code config directory. Empty uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, then ~/.claude.

claudeTracker.historyLimit.description: Maximum number of recent prompts sent to the dashboard table.

enumDescriptions: Today since midnight
Rolling last 24 hours (1D)
7 days
2 weeks
3 weeks
30 days
90 days
1 year
All history
claudeTracker.defaultRange.description: Date range the dashboard opens with.

enumDescriptions: Show how much of each rate-limit window is left.
Show how much of each rate-limit window has been consumed, like Claude Code's /usage.
claudeTracker.quotaDisplay.description: Whether the status bar, pills, meters and charts show how much of each 5-hour and weekly window is left or how much has been used.

claudeTracker.warningAtUsedPercent.description: Percent of a 5-hour or weekly window used at which it turns to the warning colour. Always a "used" percentage, whichever way limits are displayed.

claudeTracker.criticalAtUsedPercent.description: Percent of a 5-hour or weekly window used at which it turns to the critical colour. Must be at least the warning threshold; a lower value is raised to match it.

enumDescriptions: Fill the status-bar entry with the theme's warning (orange) or error (red) background. VS Code only allows these two theme colours as backgrounds.
Colour only the text, using claudeTracker.warningColor and claudeTracker.criticalColor.
claudeTracker.statusBarHighlight.description: How the status-bar entry shows the warning and critical levels.

claudeTracker.statusBarShowResets.description: Show when the 5-hour and weekly windows reset in the status bar (for example "5H: 64% / Rst: 19:00").

claudeTracker.normalColor.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fbca8, or leave empty for the default.
claudeTracker.normalColor.description: Colour for a window below the warning threshold, as #rrggbb. Empty uses the theme colour in the status bar and the Claude orange in the dashboard.

claudeTracker.warningColor.description: Colour at or above the warning threshold, as #rrggbb. Used for status-bar text when statusBarHighlight is "text", and always in the dashboard.
claudeTracker.warningColor.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #e8a23a.

claudeTracker.criticalColor.description: Colour at or above the critical threshold, as #rrggbb. Used for status-bar text when statusBarHighlight is "text", and always in the dashboard.
claudeTracker.criticalColor.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #e5484d.

enumDescriptions: Recommended. Follow your VS Code colour theme, so text and backgrounds stay readable in any theme.
Always use the tracker's dark theme, whatever VS Code is using.
Always use the tracker's light theme, whatever VS Code is using.
Black background, white text and bright accents. Maximum contrast.
claudeTracker.theme.description: Base colours for the dashboard: background, cards, text and borders. The status bar always follows your VS Code theme.

enumDescriptions: Claude orange, teal, violet and blue.
Okabe-Ito colours that stay distinguishable with the common forms of colour-vision deficiency.
Blues, teals and violets.
Oranges, ambers and pinks.
Bright, saturated colours with strong separation.
Use the colours listed in claudeTracker.customChartColors.
claudeTracker.chartPalette.description: Colours for chart series, model and project bars and the heatmap.

items.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fb950.

claudeTracker.customChartColors.markdownDescription: Up to ten hex colours for chart series, used when `claudeTracker.chartPalette` is `custom`. The first colour is also the heatmap colour. Missing slots use the default palette.

accent.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fb950.
accent.description: Highlights: active range, buttons, normal meter fill and the first chart colour.

marker.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fb950.
marker.description: The vertical time-remaining marker on the limit meters.

background.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fb950.

surface.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fb950.

text.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fb950.

mutedText.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fb950.
mutedText.description: Secondary text: labels, captions and axis text.

border.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex colour such as #3fb950.

claudeTracker.colors.markdownDescription: Override individual dashboard colours on top of the chosen `claudeTracker.theme`. Leave a colour out to keep the theme value. You are warned if text becomes hard to read.

claudeTracker.notifyOnThreshold.description: Show a notification when the 5-hour or weekly window crosses the warning or critical threshold.

claudeTracker.showCostInStatusBar.description: Include today's API-equivalent cost in the status-bar entry.

claudeTracker.planMonthlyPriceUsd.description: Your Claude subscription price per month (for example 20, 100 or 200). When set, the dashboard shows how much API-equivalent usage your plan delivered. 0 hides it.

claudeTracker.pricingOverrides.markdownDescription: Per-model price overrides in USD per million tokens, keyed by model id prefix. Example: `{ "claude-opus-5-5": { "input": 4, "output": 20, "cacheRead": 0.2 } }`. Cache writes default to 1.25x (5m) and 2x (1h) input when omitted.

enumDescriptions: Share card order and sizes across all VS Code windows.
Keep card order and sizes specific to this workspace.
claudeTracker.layoutScope.description: Where dashboard card layout is stored.

claudeTracker.limitsPollMinutes.markdownDescription: How often, in minutes, to read your 5-hour and weekly limits by running Claude Code's local `/usage` command (no model call, no tokens). Works even when you only use the VS Code chat panel. `0` turns polling off and relies on the statusline bridge.

claudeTracker.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Fallback rescan interval. File-change events trigger refreshes sooner.

claudeTracker.outputDebug.description: Log detailed scan, bridge and pricing diagnostics to the output channel.
